title: DAOPower
tagline: DAO Power is the total wealth held by the specific DAO community
description: Creating deeper insights into the narrative and story behind community of a DAO. Looking at their collective wealth, token holdings categories, how active they are on chain and where. We want to create a tool so the members and owners of the DAO can better understand their token holders as well as associated projects through memberships of other DAOs.
how_its_made: Using covalent API endpoints we are able to gather the raw data needed. Particularly the DAO members addresses, and then the holdings of each address as a starting point. We then cross reference the price for tokens with Covalent API. We present the data using Streamlit to aggregate the data so that we can display the token holdings of users and the dollar amounts of each of the tokens owned by DAO members.
